result.title: VibeVideoAgent: Closing the Perceptual Loop for Code-Driven Video Generation
result.summary: Code-driven video generation asks a coding agent to write and run rendering programs. This gives exact control over typography, data visualizations, synchronized audio, and multi-shot scenes, and it leaves an editable project behind. A program that exits cleanly can still render overlapping labels, a camera aimed away from its subject, broken object interactions, or narration that drifts out of sync, and none of these raise a runtime error. Feeding rendered frames and audio back into the coding session bloats its long-horizon context, while critiquing only the finished full-resolution render turns early design mistakes into costly rewrites. We introduce VibeVideoAgent, a training-free framework that lets coding agents inspect their drafts throughout production. Multimodal perception runs in short-lived contexts kept apart from the coder and returns compact, grounded Findings. Seven primitives operate on a unified multi-clock representation of assets and drafts: they explore media from coarse to fine, verify quoted requirements with evidence from every required modality, compare a draft with a reference or an earlier revision on separate clocks, and measure stream signals locally. A lightweight staged protocol has the agent test its riskiest decision on a minimal preview first. On all 239 VibeVideoBench tasks, with matched agent runtimes and a fixed perception model, VibeVideoAgent improves holistic audiovisual quality (L3) for Claude Opus 5.5 (4.03 -> 4.43, while L2 rubric compliance rises from 98.87% to 99.35%), GPT-6 Astra (4.03 -> 4.27), and Claude Sonnet 5.5 (3.97 -> 4.10), with the largest gains in audio-visual synchronization (up to +0.56). Controlled ablations show that each component contributes, and trajectory audits show that the granularity of code edits governs the trade-off between rubric adherence and perceptual quality.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 VibeVideoAgent，让代码驱动的视频生成智能体在生产过程中反复检视草稿：感知在独立短上下文中运行并返回紧凑的 grounded Findings，配合从粗到细探索、带证据的需求核查、分时钟对比与流信号局部测量等七种原语，并先用最小预览检验风险最高的决策。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把感知与推理上下文分离、只回传紧凑证据」以及「先低成本预览验证高风险假设」的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与何时继续 LOOK 的停止决策提供概念参照，但领域为视频生成，需核查可迁移性。
